name: 奉仕の欠席履歴カード
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse LH11-0019 奉仕の欠席履歴カード. Image1 ORIGINAL Deputy source has priority for card/button/status anatomy, optical proportions, alignment, spacing and fine controls. Image2 Japanese mock is SECONDARY localized copy/layout guide. Image3 approved bus is white surface/forest-action style only. Target original Leave section header plus one dated history card, not profile, recent timesheets or sidebar.
Pure white #FFFFFF canvas, compact logical390px width and about168px height to retain original section action. Header small bold14/24 「欠席」 at left, small forest-gradient primary 「新しく申請」 at right, restoring source Add new omitted by mock. Below, a narrow neutral date column OUTSIDE the white card: regular12/16 「日曜日」, bold20/28 「18」, regular12/16 「10月」 stacked. To its right one WHITE rounded history card with fine neutral outline and soft downward shadow. Top-left regular14/24 title 「予定によるお休み」; top-right small FOREST-GREEN PLAIN TEXT status 「承認済み」, following source simple Approved label, not mock's mint badge. Quiet12/16 「3時間」 beneath title. Bottom-right small WHITE neutral-outline secondary button 「見る」 with forest-green label, faithfully restoring source View button anatomy instead of a bare mock text link.
Keep exact localized date/type/duration/status and one history entry; no extra year, people, timesheets, metrics or dates. Meiryo role typography as above, zero tracking, preserve wrapping and restrained hierarchy. Original purple Add new/View are real actions: adapt small primary to smooth135degree #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E with white legible label and gentle edge light; secondary View stays WHITE. Original green approval meaning retained forest green text. No additional accents, icons, mint chips, gray canvas, glow, gloss or app chrome. Compact precise original alignment and button optical proportions outrank rough mock omissions. Static raster candidate only, no actual leave request/history-navigation behavior claimed.
reviewNotes: 原画優先で欠席/新規申請ヘッダ操作、左日付列、白履歴カード、右上承認状態、白い見るボタンを復元。保存日曜日18/10月/予定によるお休み/3時間/承認済み保持。ミント状態面を除外、森林緑の主操作/状態と中立白面。生成実見で切れ/不足なし確認。実申請/履歴表示/正確な書体同定は未検証、画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
